contract: Validate the exact packet against the current assignment and baseline before recall. Keep further content lookup inside its exact document references.

Return the literal equation and label together with the raw source SHA256 and locator. The extractor returns a section block starting at line 1; the equation itself is on line 2. Do not expand macros, compile TeX, or infer scientific verification.

Count the equation source once under research/fixture.tex. Preserve separate path, digest and locator for each representation only when an explicit source relationship establishes that it represents the same underlying evidence. This packet contains one TeX representation; it proves no TeX/PDF pairing.

Use the frozen active prior decision only as accepted design for explicit representation identity. Its README citation remains design provenance. Neither the decision nor README is an additional independent proof of the equation.

Prefer the exact label for precision. The equation query also returns incidental lexical hits; ranking scores alone do not establish evidence or authority. Verify the returned source kind, literal, label, digest and locator.
